text:
The wind blew and carried off the clouds,

and in the clouds a peacock sailed,

and the peacock was meant for my hand,

and my hand is going to wither away,

and this morning I gave that hand

to the king who came to make me his bride.


Oh, the sky, oh, the wind, and the cloud

that drift away with the peacock!

translation.title: The Peacock
translation.editorial_note: The cumulative and keeps the ballad-like spell while sailed makes the peacock's impossible passage vivid.
